description: This header file declares the WifiManager class, which implements the WifiManagerInterface, PluginHost::IPlugin, and PluginHost::JSONRPC interfaces for managing WiFi functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes method declarations for WiFi operations, event handling, and internal state management.

classes.name: WifiManager
classes.description: A plugin class that manages WiFi operations within WPEFramework, implementing interfaces for plugin management, JSONRPC communication, and WiFi functionality, with internal state management and event handling.
